summary: First-pass smoke test of ANCRD MVP. Backend: all critical /api endpoints working (login, me, users=49, posts=60, communities=12, events=18, opportunities=12, marketplace=12, institutions=12, notifications, threads=6, admin stats, create post, react, comment, join, rsvp, apply, book, send message, AIAH Claude 4.5 streaming). Frontend: login flow works, feed composer creates posts, reactions increment, ecosystem sidebar navigation works, communities join, events RSVP, opportunities apply, marketplace book, messages send, notifications render 12 items, admin stat cards show correct counts, Discover Leaflet map renders with filters, AIAH FAB opens panel and initiates streaming to Claude 4.5.
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT + user
GET /api/auth/me returns current user
GET /api/users returns 49 seeded users with full profile fields (avatar, banner, disciplines, portfolio_score, verification_level)
GET /api/posts returns 60 posts each with author object attached
POST /api/posts creates new post
POST /api/posts/{id}/react with {reaction:'like'} returns ok
POST /api/posts/{id}/comment appends comment
GET /api/communities returns 12; POST join returns ok
GET /api/events returns 18; POST rsvp returns ok
GET /api/opportunities returns 12; POST apply returns ok
GET /api/marketplace returns 12; POST book creates booking
GET /api/messages/threads returns 6 threads with 'other' user attached; GET /api/messages/{tid} returns messages; POST /api/messages creates message
GET /api/institutions returns 12 with lat/lng
GET /api/notifications returns 12 items
GET /api/admin/stats returns correct counts
POST /api/aiah/ask streams non-empty plain-text response from Claude Sonnet 4.5 within <2s (curl produced 'Hello, Aaron Sterling.')
Frontend login redirects to /feed with demo creds
Feed composer creates a post; new post appears at top
Reaction react-like-<postId> increments count 0 -> 1
Ecosystem sidebar visible; nav-communities navigates to /communities
Community join-<id> button works
Events rsvp-<id>, Opportunities apply-<id>, Marketplace book-<id> buttons work
Messages: 6 threads render, msg-input/msg-send send message
Notifications page renders 12 notif-<id> items
Admin page shows stat-users=49 and stat-institutions=12
Discover /discover renders global-map (Leaflet) and filter-country/discipline/role selects
AIAH FAB opens aiah-panel; aiah-input+aiah-send trigger streaming (streaming indicator visible)

failed.issue: POST /api/posts/{id}/react body field name mismatch with review request wording. Server (and frontend) use {reaction: 'like'}; review doc said 'kind'. Frontend and backend agree; only doc wording is off.
failed.evidence: curl with {kind:'like'} -> 422 'Field required reaction'. With {reaction:'like'} -> {ok:true}. Frontend FeedPage.jsx already sends { reaction: key }.
